thought: Start with the alert: what is failing and how badly?
Pull error rate, latency, pool, disk and db numbers for the last 30s to see which subsystem looks off.
Pull the recent ERROR lines. If more than one cause is active, they should both show up.

The ERROR lines show TWO different failures mixed together: 'connection refused db-prod-02:5432 while opening checkout transaction' and 'OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device'. One cause doesn't explain both, so I'm testing each. The cache-miss, deprecated /v1/cart and slow /reports lines appear in every window and don't line up with the 5xx errors, so I'm ignoring them.
